content: Abram Lot-galesad-onosad
Deunni, we-reymar negdakmamaid:
A-ibagangi, deunni, we-reymar-walabakegwad, baigan-reymar-ataled-ebo bila-onogega na atosmalad. We-reymar-walataled atosmarmogad:
Wemar-e-ataled, e-sordamar Sidim-nebagi urbisad, Demar-Gagbidye-nugad-walik.
Rey-Quedorlaomer birgambe-gakabogus (12) we-reymar-walataled-e-dummadga-gudigu, we-reymar-walataled birgambe-gakapaagusgu (13), sogdemalad: “Anmar we-rey-Quedorlaomerʼgi gwisguergeboye.”

Birgagwen-nasad-sorba, Quedorlaomer, degine, reymar-eba-nanaimalad Astarot-Karnaim-yalagansik bila-ononadmalad. Agine Refa-dulemargi nakwismalad. A-sorba, Hamʼgi Zuz-dulemargi nakwismalad. Geb Save-Quiriataimʼgi Emita-dulemargi nakwismalad.
Seir-yalagangindi Horí-dulemargi nakwismalad, Parán-nebase baregichamalad. We-Paránʼde nega-dulesulid-walik naid.

Quedorlaomer, degine, reymar-eba-gudidimalad we-dulemar-sogabakegwadgi-nakwisgu, gannar aibiris armalad. Geb Enmispatʼye-neg-nugadse nonimalad. We-Enmispatʼde, Cadesʼye nugbalid. Rey-Quedorlaomer, degi, reymar-eba-gudidimalad Amalec-dulemar-yalaganba bela ibmar obelonadap gusmalad. Deyob Amorreo-dulemar-imaksamarbalid. We-Amorreo-dulemarde Hazezon-Tamar-yalagangi bukwamalanad.
Agi, we-reymar-e-ataled, baigan-reymar-warbakegwadbo uludmalad. Ebo-ulusmaladi, wemalad:

Dakargua, bela Sidim-nebagi yaa-dummagan-bukidar-bukwa nanaed. We-yaa-dummagande barya-yaisur nikad. Sodoma-e-rey, degi, Gomorra-e-rey urwenanaigua, wakite gusmalanad. Degi-inigwele, yaa-dummadgi argwatapmalad. E-sordamar-baigandi yalaganba wakitemalad.
Reymar-nakwismaladi, Sodoma-neggweburgi, degi, Gomorra-neggweburgi, bela masgullemalad, degi, bela ibmar-nuegan sesmalad.
Ar Abram-niga-Lot, Sodomaʼgi-maimosoggu, reymar-nakwisad Lot-sesa gusmarmogad, degi, bela e-ibmar-nikad e-ibe sesa gusmarbalid.

Ar dule-wargwen nabir wakichasoggu, Abramʼga bela ibmar sognonikid. Abramʼde Hebreo-duled. Abramʼde Amorreo-dule-e-sapi-dummagan-walik maid. We-Amorreo-dulede Mamreʼye nugad. Mamreʼdi, gwenadgan nikad, amarde wemalad: Escol, Aner. Wemala, Abramʼba naimaladid.

Abram itoargu e-niga gales-selesye, geb e-maimar-e-neg-yagi-gwalulesmaladse gochad. Wemarde bila-onomaladid. Belagwapa dulataled-ilapaa gakambe-gakabaabak (318) mergued. Amarmala, Dan-neggweburse reymar-Lot-gasa-sesmalad-balegitemalad.

Abram, dulemar-eba-nadapmalad danar-danar oambikusgu, mutikidba ukiar reymargi ubodapmalad. Abram, degi, e-sordamarmala, emargi nakwismargu, we-reymar-wakitemalad Hoba-neggweburse balegichamalad. Hobaʼde Damasco-neggwebur-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik siid.

We-reymar-ibmar-sesadi, Abram bela gannar susad. Deyobi, Abram e-niga-Lot-galesad onosad, degi, bela gannar Lot-e-ibmar susbalid. Deginbali, omegan-onosbalid, degi, bela dule-baigan-galesmalad amba onosbalid.
Melquisedec Abramʼgi ise-nued binsasad
Abram Quedorlaomerʼgi, degi, Quedorlaomerʼba-reymar-gudidimaladgi nakwis-danigua, Sodoma-e-rey, Save-neba-naidgi Abram-abindakega abin noalid. Save-nebade Rey-Nebaye nugbalid.
Geb degine, Salem-e-rey-Melquisedec, madu, degi, vino Abramʼga senonikid. We-Melquisedecʼde dule-irwa-Bab-Dummad-Bur-Biriginedse-goledid.
Geb degine, Melquisedec, Abramʼgi ise-nued-binsaedgi, weyob sogded:

content.text: We-Bab-Dummad, nibneg, degi, napneg bela obinnisadid.

content: Geb degine, Abram bela ibmar-gannar-susadi, yopira-emarbi-sogambegi (10) mamarisad. A-gwensak Melquisedecʼga uksad (10%).
Geb degine, Sodoma-e-rey Abramʼga sogded: —Dulemarbi be anga udage. Ibmarmardi be sue.
Ar Abramʼdi abin-sogded: —Suli. Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Jehováʼga ise-sogar an imaksad. We-Bab-Dummadde nibneg, degi, napneg bela obinnisad.
Aga, an sogsad: ‘Bipisaale ibmar an be-ibe suosurye, dubamar, degi, sapat-dubse-bakar, an-nag-uka-edinnega gwen an bei suosurye. Adi, melle be an-annik sogega, an we-dule mani-ibedga imaksaye.’
Andi an ibmar abesulid. Unnila sapingana-anba-gudidimalad-e-mas-guchamaladbi anga unnigualed. Degine, dule-anba-arbimalad, Aner, Escol, degi, Mamre, amardi igar-maidba ibmar sumaloed.
